quote: There are 4 Different versions of the Slumbering Coil Curio
notes: Original Method article links four difficulty-specific PTR Wowhead bonus sequences for the SAME base token item 270909. Exact linked variants: [["LFR",[13332],"https://www.wowhead.com/ptr/item=270909/slumbering-coil-curio?bonus=13332"],["Normal",[12847],"https://www.wowhead.com/ptr/item=270909/slumbering-coil-curio?bonus=12847"],["Heroic",[12855,13334],"https://www.wowhead.com/ptr/item=270909/slumbering-coil-curio?bonus=12855:13334"],["Mythic",[13335,13848],"https://www.wowhead.com/ptr/item=270909/slumbering-coil-curio?bonus=13335:13848"]]. These are SOURCE-LINK bonus strings, not verified client itemLinks or direct vendor inventories. Source reports trade for any Venomous Abyss tier token at Silvermoon, 5 armor slots, and Heroic Sszorak leg reward example ilvl 305; do not extrapolate item levels to token itself. Method body says Ki'rula yet waypoint says Kirana and item tooltip says Kirana; retain prior vendor Kirana pending client confirmation. Do not invent 20 enumerated rewards, token-to-piece mappings or drop rates. No completed processing cohort and not an output measurement.
